validation.date_order: start_date <= end_date (reversed bounds rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR)

attendance_collection.purpose: Return a complete server-authoritative attendance snapshot for trusted clients and exports without requiring unbounded client pagination.
attendance_collection.safety_limit: 50000 rows; requests reaching the limit fail with VALIDATION_ERROR

pagination.limit: integer equal to returned row count

monthly_attendance_sources.purpose: Return the existing academic, enrollment, schedule, calendar-exception, student, and leave sources required to build a complete Monthly Attendance Recap.
monthly_attendance_sources.leave_request_range_semantics: GET /v1/admin/leave-requests returns periods overlapping the inclusive WIB range: requested_start_date <= end_date and COALESCE(effective_end_date, original_end_date, requested_start_date) >= start_date. A legacy approved row with only date is a one-day period.
monthly_attendance_sources.response: Versioned success envelope; list resources return complete arrays or valid offset pagination metadata.

post_fields.end_date: YYYY-MM-DD within month required, start_date <= end_date
post_fields.checksum: sha256 lowercase 64-character hex required for both completed and failed results

status_response.rule: completed=true only when a persisted matching details.result=completed log exists, using latest completed record and strictly validating canonical completed fields without fabricating defaults. No completed record, including failed-only, returns completed=false and record=null. Backend failure or corrupted log details still throws.

idempotency.delete_by_id: Repeated deletion leaves the resource absent; a later call may return RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
idempotency.leave_reopen: Repeated reopen leaves the request pending and clears rejection state.
idempotency.other_mutations: Not retryable unless an operation-specific idempotency key is documented.

adiwiyata_dashboard.authorization: Bearer Logto access token with mobile:access; approved Astra student profile and active Eligibility keyed by user_id
adiwiyata_dashboard.period_and_enrollment: Requires exactly one active Academic Period and exactly one active Class Enrollment for the caller in that Period; the Class is never caller-supplied
adiwiyata_dashboard.school_day: Server WIB date; an active schedule for the same school and Academic Period matching the Class or period-wide general (class_id is null) enables the weekday; exact-Class schedules override general schedules; other schools, periods, classes, and periodless global schedules do not apply; schedule hours are ignored; a holiday calendar exception suppresses the day
adiwiyata_dashboard.configuration_error: Missing or ambiguous Academic Period or Enrollment, a Class outside the current school/period, zero active schedules for the current school/period, or duplicate schedules at today's chosen specificity returns 503 ADIWIYATA_CONFIGURATION_ERROR; a configured weekday with no applicable schedule is not_scheduled
adiwiyata_dashboard.ineligible_error: A non-eligible user receives 403 ADIWIYATA_NOT_ELIGIBLE with a recovery message

response.academic_period: The unique active Astra Academic Period
response.class: The caller's unique active Astra Class Enrollment
response.sites: Active Sites for the caller's Class or general Sites only; each includes coverage_status, own_report, and can_report
response.own_report: Only this student's report fields, canonical file_created_at and signed photo URL; null when the student has not submitted
response.can_report: True only on a school day before this student submits and before the Class-Site is verified

adiwiyata_report_submission.authorization: Bearer Logto access token with mobile:access; approved student profile, one active current-period enrollment, and active Adiwiyata eligibility

fields.image: Exactly one JPEG or PNG file, maximum 5 MiB

request.extra_fields: Rejected; client date, name, class, and captions are never accepted
request.image_validation: Astra checks the decoded JPEG/PNG format and limits decoded pixels to 20 million
request.authority: Astra resolves the active Class and profile name; server WIB time/date are captured after image decoding; uploads have no schedule-hour restriction

adiwiyata_report_submission.output: Permanently watermarked JPEG, maximum 2 MiB, stored in the dedicated S3_BUCKET_ADIWIYATA bucket with Astra file metadata
adiwiyata_report_submission.response: 201 envelope data is {report:{id,site_id,class_id,file_id,report_date,created_at,file_created_at,photo_url}}; photo_url may be null if signing fails after commit
adiwiyata_report_submission.uniqueness: PostgreSQL UNIQUE(site_id, reported_by, report_date) rejects concurrent duplicate student/site/WIB-date uploads, independent of Class changes
adiwiyata_report_submission.verification_closure: The report transaction rechecks current eligibility, active enrollment, Site visibility, school day, duplicate, and verified Class-Site closure under the shared pg_advisory_xact_lock name adiwiyata-report:{classId}:{siteId}:{date}; ticket 06 verify/unverify uses the same name
adiwiyata_report_submission.storage_compensation: Create pending Astra file metadata before PUT. On failed upload or report commit, delete the object and mark metadata deleted only after confirmed delete; retain pending metadata if cleanup fails
adiwiyata_report_submission.student_privacy: Dashboard returns only this student's report; admin file reads require files:read:any and an approved Astra school_admin/platform_admin profile
adiwiyata_report_submission.ordinary_file_lifecycle: Generic file upload/confirm/delete cannot create, activate, or remove Adiwiyata evidence; expiry is 365 days and the signed URL never lasts beyond that deadline

adiwiyata_admin_sites.authorization: Bearer Logto access token with admin:read; approved Astra profile role is school_admin or platform_admin
adiwiyata_admin_sites.school_scope: Uses the school of Astra's unique active Academic Period; lists include active and inactive Sites for that school
adiwiyata_admin_sites.class_mapping: class_id is null for a general Site or references a Class in the unique active Academic Period and same school; rollover mapping is explicit and never inferred by class name

fields.name: trimmed non-empty string, maximum 120 characters
fields.class_id: UUID or null; optional on create and patch
fields.sort_order: finite non-negative 32-bit integer; defaults to 0 on create

adiwiyata_admin_sites.deactivation: DELETE sets is_active=false and retains the Site row and report history

adiwiyata_admin_reports.authorization: Bearer Logto access token with admin:read; approved Astra profile role is school_admin or platform_admin

query.date: Strict real YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to server WIB today
query.class_id: Optional UUID; includes historical Classes from this school without a current-period filter

adiwiyata_admin_reports.school_scope: Uses the school of Astra's unique active Academic Period; report Class and Site must both belong to that school
adiwiyata_admin_reports.listing: Reports contain actual submissions. Coverage for server WIB today additionally includes active visible Sites once per Class with an approved, active-enrolled eligible student; scoped schedules and holidays determine missing or not_scheduled. Historical dates contain only reported/verified pairs from actual submissions, including inactive Sites and historical Classes.
adiwiyata_admin_reports.photo_access: can_view_photos is true only with files:read:any and the approved Astra admin role; without that scope, photo_url is null while report metadata remains visible

response.today: Server-authoritative current WIB date in YYYY-MM-DD
response.can_view_photos: Whether this administrator has the approved role and files:read:any scope
response.reports: Array of {id,site_id,site_name,category,class_id,class_name,reported_by,uploader_name,file_id,file_created_at,report_date,created_at,verified_at,verified_by,photo_url}; expired photos retain metadata and have photo_url=null
response.coverage: Array of {class_id,class_name,site_id,site_name,category,coverage_status,photo_count,reason}; status is not_scheduled, missing, reported, or verified; only today's expected pairs can be missing/not_scheduled
response.filter_options: Classes and Sites present in the unfiltered date coverage, each as {id,name}; applying one filter does not erase other choices

adiwiyata_admin_reports.verification: Verify/unverify re-reads the report under the shared Class-Site-WIB-date transaction advisory lock; actor, action, previous and next verification state, and time are recorded atomically in audit_logs. Repeated identical mutations do not add audit rows.
adiwiyata_admin_reports.upload_closure: The first verified report closes uploads for its Class-Site-date; un-verifying the last verified report returns coverage to reported. Student uploads still use only the current server WIB date, so historical unverify does not open backdated uploads.

adiwiyata_admin_eligibility.authorization: Bearer Logto access token with admin:read; approved Astra profile role is school_admin or platform_admin
adiwiyata_admin_eligibility.search: Reuses Astra student profiles and active enrollment data; name and email are display/search fields, and q is case-insensitive

student_fields.user_id: Astra profile user_id, the only grant key
student_fields.current_class: The unique active enrollment class in Astra's unique active Academic Period, or null when unavailable
student_fields.can_grant: true only for an approved student profile with exactly one valid active enrollment in the current period
student_fields.reason: Explains a missing profile, role, approval, period, enrollment, or matching class when access cannot be granted

adiwiyata_admin_eligibility.grant: POST accepts only {user_id}; the profile must be an approved student with one active same-school, current-period class enrollment; unique user_id upsert reactivates the same row
adiwiyata_admin_eligibility.revoke: DELETE sets is_active=false immediately and retains eligibility metadata and student report history; revocation does not require current eligibility
adiwiyata_admin_eligibility.listing: GET returns search matches and all existing eligibility rows, including inactive rows; class is resolved from the current Astra enrollment and is never copied into eligibility

row.class_id: existing class id optional when class_name is supplied

ownership.clients: must not access PostgreSQL, storage, Robin, or Logto Management API
